verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations, such as batch inference over many inputs, are a fair axis for an LLM model family and its tooling, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only per-model CLI commands (list, download, verify-download, prompt-format) and single-call usage, with no batch or bulk capability. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
